subject: english
title: My Experience · Q3 W13 D01
objective: Express an idea about a personal experience in clear sentences.
introduction: Milo visited the school garden! 🌱 Tell what happened, where it was, how you felt, and what you learned.

vocabulary.definition: The event that took place in a personal experience.

The feeling a writer experienced during an event.

items.prompt: Which sentence tells about the garden event?

options.text: I planted a seed in the garden.
The bus is blue.
A spoon is on the table.
The bell is loud.

items.explanation: The sentence tells something you did during the visit — you planted a seed. The bus, the spoon, and the bell are not part of the garden visit.

options.text: The bus is blue.
The garden was beside our classroom.
A spoon is on the table.
The bell is loud.

items.explanation: The sentence names the place — the garden beside the classroom. The other sentences do not tell where the visit happened.

options.text: The bus is blue.
A spoon is on the table.
I felt excited when a leaf appeared.
The bell is loud.

items.explanation: The sentence tells a feeling — excited — when a leaf appeared. The other sentences tell about the bus, a spoon, and the bell, not about feelings.

items.prompt: Which sentence tells the lesson learned?

options.text: The bus is blue.
A spoon is on the table.
The bell is loud.
I learned that plants need care.

items.explanation: The sentence tells what you learned — that plants need care. The other sentences do not tell a lesson from the visit.

items.prompt: Which sentence is a good detail for your garden story?

options.text: I planted a seed in the garden.
The bus is blue.
A spoon is on the table.
The bell is loud.

items.explanation: It tells what you did during the visit, so it belongs in your garden story. The bus, the spoon, and the bell have nothing to do with the garden.
